text:
This HTTP 401 authentication error occurs when Hermes attempts to use a remote API endpoint (or trigger a fallback provider) that lacks valid API keys or authentication credentials.

To configure and route exclusively to your local **Ollama** instance, update your configuration (e.g., `~/.hermes/config.yaml`) with the following settings:

```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/<model-name>
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

### Key Points:
1. **Avoid `provider: auto`**: Explicitly set `provider: custom` so Hermes does not try to auto-detect and route queries to external providers.
2. **Clear `fallback_providers`**: Setting `fallback_providers: []` ensures Hermes will not attempt to fall back to remote services when errors occur.
3. **Replace `<model-name>`**: Use your installed Ollama model (e.g., `ollama/hermes3:8b`, `ollama/llama3.1`).
